name: go2_baton_deploy
title: Go2 BATON deploy runtime — the quadruped counterpart of g1_shadow_deploy
summary: The runtime env identical across every Go2 BATON demo: the engine block (byte-for-byte run_go2_shadow_deploy.sh's, so results stay comparable with the Shadowing head-to-head), the gait block (which MUST match the ghost lut's own gait), the corridor, and the quadruped BATON gate. Note what is NOT here and IS in g1_shadow_deploy: a crane. Quadrupeds carry no harness — a G1 BATON demo rides a weight-bearing rig at HARNESS_KZ=2000, and this one rides nothing.

notes.GO2_GHOST_FF: MANDATORY for this robot, not a preference: the Go2 ghost's peak |ctrl - q| is 0.217 rad at kp=250, which EXCEEDS the 0.15 corridor — the reference is untrackable by corridor alone BY CONSTRUCTION. The declared feedforward shifts the corridor centre so the residual only has to supply corrections.
notes.BATON_DS_GATE: 1 -- consult the support gate. It was 0 on the theory that a statically stable trotter has no forbidden hand-over instant; a LIVE RUN REFUTED THAT (a walk:12 switch landed mid-swing, the Go2 tripped and flipped onto its back at t=12.83 s, then kept 'walking' inverted at gmatch 0.92). The Go2 host gates on the gait model's FOUR-FOOT SUPPORT windows (duty 0.6 -> ~20% of the cycle).
notes.no_harness: There is deliberately no HARNESS_* block here. Quadrupeds carry no crane.
